scope: Two bounded Apple AFM events: one family announcement and one first arXiv submission. No weights, availability, model execution or complete-coverage claim.

title.zh: Apple AFM 2025 端侧与服务器模型家族公告
title.en: Apple AFM 2025 on-device and server family announcement

summary.zh: Apple 标注 2025-06-09 的公告介绍面向设备和服务器的新一代基础语言模型，以及供应用开发者使用的 Foundation Models framework。公告未登记时刻或时区。
summary.en: Apple’s announcement dated June 9, 2025 introduces a new generation of on-device and server foundation language models and the Foundation Models framework for app developers. No publication time or timezone is recorded.

note.zh: 一条家族公告，不是两次权重开放。该页面明确于 2025-07-17 更新图表，以对应技术报告的模型版本和评测；当前指标不能当作六月公告的历史快照。端侧模型接口不等于服务器模型的公共 API。公开权重日期、权重许可与当前地区/设备/账户可用性未核实；未调用模型或复现评测。
note.en: One family announcement, not two weights releases. The page explicitly says its figures were updated on July 17, 2025 for the report’s model versions and evaluations; current metrics are not a June announcement snapshot. Access to the on-device model does not establish a public server-model API. Public weights dates, weights licenses and current regional, device or account availability are unverified. No model or evaluation was run.

title.zh: Apple AFM 2025 技术报告首次 arXiv 提交
title.en: Apple AFM 2025 technical report first arXiv submission

summary.zh: arXiv 历史记录 v1 提交为 2025-07-17 23:37:19 UTC。报告讨论端侧与服务器基础语言模型；端侧强调效率，服务器采用 Parallel-Track MoE。此处定位到 v1，而不是当前最新修订。
summary.en: arXiv records v1 on July 17, 2025 at 23:37:19 UTC. The report describes on-device and server foundation language models, emphasizing on-device efficiency and Parallel-Track MoE on the server. This record pins v1, not the latest revision.

note.zh: 这是首次 arXiv 提交，不是六月家族公告的重复记录，也不是新权重或 API 发布。它不证明报告在所有渠道的最早公开时刻。作者评测未由本站复现；论文许可不能替代权重许可，权重日期、权重许可及固定 API 修订均未核实。
note.en: A first arXiv submission, distinct from the June family announcement and not a new weights or API release. It does not establish the report’s earliest public appearance across all channels. Author evaluations were not reproduced here. A paper license is not a weights license; weights dates, weights licenses and pinned API revisions are unverified.
